questionText:
Match the mass media milestone in List I with its pioneer/feature in List II:

List I:
(A) First Indian Printed Newspaper
(B) Father of Indian Cinema
(C) All India Radio (AIR)
(D) Doordarshan

List II:
(I) Hicky's Bengal Gazette (1780)
(II) Dadasaheb Phalke (Raja Harishchandra, 1913)
(III) Akashvani — state public radio broadcasting network
(IV) State public television network launched experimentally in Delhi (1959)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Mass Media Forms & Pioneers.

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Mass Media Forms & Pioneers (Structure of Indian Society):
Hicky's Bengal Gazette was first newspaper; Dadasaheb Phalke pioneered cinema; Akashvani is AIR; Doordarshan was state TV.
Hence, Option B is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
